messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

But now my company’s calling us back to the office—classic plot twist, right? I’m hoping to return the office items and keep the hiking ones, if that’s possible. Can you help me out?

**1) What’s the email address used for your order?**  
(Alternatively, tell me your **first name, last name, and zip code**.)

**2) If you already have it, please share your order id** (it looks like `#W0000000`) and—so I can confirm what’s eligible—**which items are the “office” ones vs the “hiking” ones** you want to keep.

I actually don’t have an email (I know, I’m living dangerously in 2024!), but I can give you my details:

As for the order ID… I don’t have it handy right now. Honestly, I can’t even remember exactly which items were the office ones—I just know I got three things for my home office and a few hiking items. Is there a way you can pull up my order with my name and zip? Maybe you can read me the list and I’ll tell you which ones to return?

I found **three orders** for you:

Thanks for digging those up! I’m pretty sure it’s the most recent one—#W1845024. Could you read me the items from that order? I’ll let you know which ones are the office stuff I want to return and which hiking items I want to keep.
